cases.prompt: We have finished this plan: T1 correct three spelling errors in README.md; T2 apply the same spelling correction in docs/setup.md; T3 run the existing Markdown link checker. No behavior changes. Add a cost-aware execution strategy. Runtime model is a capable standard tier; worker model routing is available, but no worker is running.
must_observe: Preserve T1-T3 and their checks; group compatible corrections.
Prefer a compact strategy and no delegation when its overhead has no defensible benefit.
Keep all changes and test execution prospective.
must_not_observe: Mandatory premium coordinator or premium final reviewer.
Running the link checker or editing project files.

cases.prompt: Plan: T1 add an input validation helper in src/validate.ts with its unit tests; T2 call it from the two request handlers in src/handlers/; T3 update docs/api.md. Session is Sonnet 5; worker routing is available but no worker has run. Add a cost-aware execution strategy. I will execute it in a separate Claude Code session started with no context, so end with everything I need to paste there.
must_observe: A closing handoff naming the execution session model and effort level with the start command or setting that selects them.
A paste-ready kick-off prompt in one block that names the plan location, the first unit to start, the attempt and launch limits, and the checks that gate completion.
Prerequisites the user completes before starting, each with a routing or capability state, or an explicit none.
must_not_observe: Calling ExitPlanMode, requesting plan approval, or offering to switch permission modes or begin implementation in this session.
A kick-off prompt that depends on this conversation to be understood.
Starting execution or editing source files.

cases.prompt: The plan and execution strategy are approved. Implement T2 now with the already selected worker and required tests. Do not replan.
must_observe: Do not activate this planning skill merely because the request mentions a plan.
Allow the applicable execution workflow to proceed under its own controls.
must_not_observe: Inserting an unsolicited fresh Execution strategy.
Replacing the already approved model allocation.
